question: Do you really make your ice cream yourselves?
answer: In our in-house production, we still put in a lot of manual work, as we create each variety from scratch ourselves. We do not rely on mass-produced goods and churn our ice cream fresh for you daily to guarantee maximum freshness. You can simply taste it with every spoon, as only genuine craftsmanship creates this special, natural melt. For us, our own production is the absolute heart of our philosophy.

question: Do you also have vegan ice cream?
answer: Everyone will find their new favorite flavor with us, which is why we always offer a colorful selection of purely plant-based ice cream varieties. In addition to our intense fruit sorbets, we regularly offer creamy options that are completely free of cow's milk. We love to experiment with different plant-based bases to offer you a great variety without compromise. Just stop by the store and discover our current vegan creations of the day.

question: What ingredients go into your ice cream?
answer: We are fully committed to transparency and only use what is truly good, honest, and natural for our recipes. Fresh milk, high-quality nuts, and sun-ripened fruits form the foundation for our first-class taste. Artificial additives or cheap substitutes have absolutely no place in our ice cream kitchen. This is the only way to create a product that we can sell to you and your loved ones with a clear conscience.

question: Can Nicezeit be booked for events?
answer: Would you like to surprise your guests with a real highlight? Our Nicezeit ice cream truck is the star of every party and brings cool refreshment directly to your desired location. Whether it's a company party, a milestone birthday, or a wedding – we take care of the smooth running and the sweet pleasure. Simply contact us for a non-binding inquiry and we will plan your very personal ice cream experience together.

question: Why are you closed in winter?
answer: When the days get shorter, we take a well-deserved winter break to gather new strength and creative ideas. Since quality is our top priority, we prefer to focus on the warm months when ice cream simply tastes best. In the meantime, we are refining new recipes and preparing everything for a brilliant start to the season in spring. We are already really looking forward to seeing you again with the first rays of sunshine!
